reviewStandard: The six queued routes failed the pre-generation transporter-identity, active-site chemistry, enzyme-family, physiological-compartment, evidence-tier, or source-completeness gate. They received no marked prompt, no built-in generation call, and no raster. Current controlled, structural, enzymological, and toxicological evidence was checked against the generated article corpus; conflicts and required resolution are preserved in the audit and review packets. Zero hashes are eligible for promotion.
promotionRule: No Batch 085 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its documented molecular identity, active-site chemistry, organism, compartment, evidence-tier, exposure, and causal conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Non-homologous permeases, ABC complexes, broad channels, metallophores, regulators, and host sequestration are merged across organisms and compartments.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by protein/complex identifier, organism/strain, topology/stoichiometry, membrane, substrate species, energy source, regulation, assay, and phenotype.

routeDecisions.reason: Valid E. coli nickel-activated glyoxalase chemistry is mixed with an incorrect reaction label and unsupported disease, diet, zinc, chelation, and antimicrobial claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define enzyme sequence/structure and organism, correct hemithioacetal chemistry and coordination, metal-activation assay, growth condition, phenotype, and evidence-qualified relevance.

routeDecisions.reason: The active-site ligation is incorrect and organism-specific acid acclimation is extended into unsupported eradication, chelation, disease, and unrelated-protein claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select organism and urease/PDB; correct histidine/aspartate/carbamylated-lysine ligation, reaction, oligomer/accessory architecture, pH/activity, phenotype, and clinical evidence.

routeDecisions.reason: Nickel ligation is incorrect and diverse oxygen-sensitive/tolerant enzymes are merged with broad pathogen, gut, biofilm, and therapeutic narratives.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define enzyme/organism/PDB, subunits and Fe-S relay, catalytic state, four-cysteine Ni ligation, directionality, electron partners, oxygen response, assay, and phenotype.

routeDecisions.reason: Mammalian NOS isoforms, microbial nitrate reduction, gastric chemistry, gut respiration, metal toxicology, and disease associations are collapsed without compartment or flux boundaries.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by cell/compartment and define enzyme, reactants/products, cofactors/oxygen, concentration/flux/time, analytical method, target, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: The sparse route omits KEAP1 turnover, stabilization, translocation, DNA binding, targets, context, assay, and source-qualified microbiome claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define NFE2L2/KEAP1 identity, species/cell, exposure/dose/time, protein state/localization, DNA-binding and target-gene readouts, metabolite provenance, and disease-specific evidence.
